rules.unique: Unique ignoring case across the list (each record of a colliding group is listed).
rules.target_prefix: Target names start with GTV, CTV, ITV or PTV. A record is a target when its snapshot Type is GTV, CTV, ITV or PTV. A target whose name starts with a helper prefix (`z` or `_`) is a helper, not checked here, and listed separately.
rules.helper_prefix: Helper or non-evaluation structures start with `z` or `_`. A record is a helper when its snapshot Type is CONTROL (any case) or its name has a helper word (opt, ring, avoid, ctrl, control, dummy, temp, help, helper) not followed by a letter; this is a heuristic, so the helpers found are listed.
rules.laterality: Laterality only as a trailing `_L` or `_R`: no `L`/`R` token before the last one, and no `Lt`, `Rt`, `Left`, `Right` or lower-case `l`/`r` token anywhere (tokens are the parts between `_`).
